text:
maya: Quick sync - I'm prototyping route+rollout metadata flowing from gateway so Console can show live quota/exposure during canaries.

simon: Nice. What's the carrier? headers or proto metadata?

maya: headers first for speed: X-RW-Route, X-RW-Rollout, X-RW-Rollout-Pct, X-RW-Quota, X-RW-Cache-Hit, X-RW-Tokens-In, X-RW-Tokens-Out

anita: headers are simplest for ELT. envoy dynamic metadata could also attach route info to spans without changing services.

simon: proto envelope would be cleaner for gRPC-first services (RouteMeta message) but it's heavier to roll out.

tom: security note: gateway must canonicalize. drop any client X-RW-* and set them itself. otherwise spoofing/attribution issues.

maya: yes gateway will strip inbound X-RW-* and inject canonical ones. Also will redact tenant IDs in public exports and emit tenant_hash for Console mapping.

anita: metrics side: need stable join keys. we'll use route_id + rollout_id. Also want rollout_pct so Console can compute expected exposure vs observed.

simon: agree. Also include cache hit tag (true/false) so billing/Optimize can split cost.

tom: for gRPC teams, let's mirror headers into a RouteMeta proto in an intercepting envoy filter so downstream services can read either. avoids touching SDKs immediately.

maya: typo? (maya) yeah that's the plan: envoy filter sets metadata proto when request is internal.

anita: we need tokens_in/tokens_out per request in telemetry to compute cost per rollout. If runtime emits it, gateway can copy into header/metadata.

simon: what about sampling? we should avoid adding too much header traffic to public clients. gateway should only add these headers for internal tenant traffic or when route is in canary.
	om: good point. default: no X-RW-* for unauthenticated public endpoints. Add them when token present or internal-origin header.

maya: rollout UX: Console needs side-by-side charts for baseline vs canary (latency, errors, cost/1k tokens). We'll wire it once pipeline has route+rollout join keys.

anita: pipeline mapping: ELT will parse X-RW-* headers from logs and traces; also accept proto RouteMeta when present. We'll add a parser stage.

simon: add schema docs please. RouteMeta proto fields: string route_id, string rollout_id, float rollout_pct, bool cache_hit, int32 tokens_in, int32 tokens_out, string quota_policy. Put it in common.proto.

maya: I'll open a small gateway PR that: strips X-RW-* from client, injects canonical X-RW-* based on route table, and sets matching dynamic metadata for envoy.
	om: add tests: ensure header stripped if client tries to set it, ensure envoy metadata present, and ensure redaction before public egress.

anita: I'll own Console wiring and dashboard template. plan: 1) add rollout dimension to existing route usage table, 2) surface percent exposure computed vs rollout_pct, 3) chart cost per 1k tokens.

simon: longer-term: RFC for moving to RouteMeta proto as the canonical carrier and SDK support next quarter. For now headers + envoy metadata is pragmatic.

maya: timeline: PR today for gateway header behavior, pipeline parser change next week, Console patch after that. canary targets: 5% then 10/25.

tom: devx-bot reminder: link runbook and create alert for mismatched rollout_pct vs observed exposure.

devx-bot: Runbook stub: https://go.redwood/rollout-telemetry-runbook (created)

maya: thanks everyone. I'll tag you on the PR and drop a short design note in #eng-platform.

simon: I'll draft the proto snippet and envoy filter example.

anita: ack, will prep dashboard queries.

tom: +1. anything else?

maya: nope - that's it. :rocket:
